description: Logical constraints over (character, attribute) maps. Loaded by functions/api/_constraints.ts and enforced by the enrichment pipeline (DQ.4). Violations are filed as attribute_disputes rows; the skeptic LLM may reconcile them in a follow-up pass. JSON (not YAML) so we avoid a runtime parser dependency; structure mirrors the YAML sketch in ROADMAP DQ.4.

constraints.reason: A character can only be one of {isHero, isVillain, isAntiHero, isNeutral} at a time.
isHuman and isAlien are mutually exclusive.
isHuman and isRobot are mutually exclusive.
isHuman and isAnimal are mutually exclusive.
isMale and isFemale are mutually exclusive at the character level.
canFly=true requires at least one of: hasWings, hasSuperpowers, isRobot.
